scope: Fixed existing O0 normal samples. Boundary inputs come only from verified original witness. Input delivery and fresh wrapper output agreement are different evidence.
not_claimed: Universal input synthesis, general semantic equivalence, candidate projection, cause attribution, detection superiority, new independent cases, N4-1 completion or N5 freeze.
derivation: Original commands.jsonl, per-case result.json and source-and-preservation-check.json; experiment record/aggregate unused.

preregistered_metadata.path_list_role: fixed denominator only, never input values or formulas

conditions.input_source: verified original witness export at discovered call path .in only
conditions.wrapper_output_source: fresh normal calculator process and separate full witness check
conditions.cache: empty per fixture; full compile key reused within fixture; separate assignments per call/input; OS cache not flushed
conditions.timing_scope: preparation; original calculation/check/export; input linking; wrapper calculation/check/export; comparison. Snapshot/version/final manifest/tests/report excluded.
conditions.execution: three fixed O0 fixtures, three existing inputs each, once. No experiment aggregate.

contract_unchanged.role: prior acceptance criteria; not implementation certification

acceptance_contract.role: prior acceptance criteria; not implementation certification

acceptance_role: prior criteria only, not independent certification of this implementation

time_accounting.reason: historical active effort unmeasured; observed process wall is not human effort or remaining budget
